{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
df_grouped = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().reset_index()

# Extract the mean values and print them with full precision to ensure they are captured
print(f"Adelie mean flipper length: {df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['species'] == 'Adelie', 'flipper_length_mm'].values[0]}")
print(f"Chinstrap mean flipper length: {df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['species'] == 'Chinstrap', 'flipper_length_mm'].values[0]}")
print(f"Gentoo mean flipper length: {df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['species'] == 'Gentoo', 'flipper_length_mm'].values[0]}")

# Find and print the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_species = df_grouped.loc[df_grouped['flipper_length_mm'].idxmax(), 'species']
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}")"}
